title: Convergent Evidence for the Five-Barrier CSRB Design: A Meta-Analytic Review of Component-Level In Vivo Validation
abstract: The Conductive Scaffold for Spinal Cord Regeneration Bridge (CSRB) proposes simultaneous addressing of five fundamental barriers to CNS regeneration in a single implant: (1) CSPG chemical barrier, (2) myelin-associated inhibitory signaling, (3) lack of aligned physical substrate, (4) axon misrouting without topographic cues, and (5) demyelination of regenerated axons.
